# dsh-priceflow
DeepSeek pricing and off-peak scheduling for DeepSeek Harness.
中文文档
## What it does
PriceFlow adds a status panel and an explicit off-peak action to the DSH conversation composer. It d
isplays the current PEAK or OFF-PEAK phase, a countdown to the next transition, official USD pricing
, and official Chinese-page CNY pricing. CNY is shown as published; it is not converted from USD and
does not drive scheduling.
During PEAK, you can queue a text message for OFF-PEAK delivery. During OFF-PEAK, ordinary DSH sendi
ng remains the normal send flow. PriceFlow can also show your DeepSeek account balance when DSH cred
entials are available.
## Requirements

- Node.js 20 or newer
- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` (DSH prereleases included)
PriceFlow has been tested against DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` and `0.2.0-rc.2`. Future `0.2.x` versions are adm
itted by the range but are not individually API-verified; Host or Client API changes may require a p
he range but are not individually API-verified; Host or Client API changes may require a plugin fix.
## Installation
In a terminal, add the npm package to the profile where you want PriceFlow installed:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replace `<profile>` with the DSH profile name. The declared DSH range is bounded below `0.3.0`; no v
ersion exemption is used. In DSH Desktop builds that expose an in-app Plugins page, use that page to
install the package into the Desktop profile.
## Features
### Phase and countdown
PriceFlow uses the official DeepSeek pricing schedule to show PEAK and OFF-PEAK and the time until t
he next transition. Phase comes from the Host pricing engine; the Client does not calculate or flip
nsition. Phase comes from the Host pricing engine; the Client does not calculate or flip it locally.
### USD and CNY pricing
USD prices come from DeepSeek's official pricing page. CNY prices come from DeepSeek's official Chin
ese pricing page. CNY is display-only and never changes the scheduler's USD pricing policy.
### Off-peak queue
During PEAK, the PriceFlow action can queue text for OFF-PEAK delivery. During OFF-PEAK, ordinary DS
H sends follow the normal DSH flow. Delayed queue sends are text-only; attachments are not supported
. Queue data survives Host restarts. Delivery uses a durable at-least-once architecture, so a messag
e may be attempted again after an interrupted delivery. A missing send API, an API error, or a respo
nse without the explicit `accepted: true` contract is rejected; the queued message is retained and i
s never marked submitted on that basis. Retryable failures use capped backoff and a finite attempt l
imit. A `submitted` status means DSH accepted the submission; it does not mean the model completed i
ts response. Delivery remains at-least-once, not exactly-once, so an interrupted request may have an
ry remains at-least-once, not exactly-once, so an interrupted request may have an uncertain outcome.
### Pricing trust
PriceFlow reads official DeepSeek pricing sources and validates the result before using it. A verifi
ed Last Known Good (LKG) policy can continue to be used after a refresh failure, with a stale-data w
arning. A bundled pricing fixture is for reference only and does not authorize scheduling. If a mode
l's price is unknown, its displayed price may be unavailable while phase detection continues.
### Holiday scheduling
Chinese public holidays are excluded from weekday PEAK scheduling. Weekends remain OFF-PEAK, includi
ng make-up work weekends. If required holiday-calendar coverage is missing, automatic scheduling fai
work weekends. If required holiday-calendar coverage is missing, automatic scheduling fails closed.
### Account balance
When DSH credentials are available, PriceFlow can request balance data from DeepSeek's official bala
nce endpoint. Balance failures do not affect pricing, phase detection, or queue scheduling.
## Privacy and local data
Queued delayed text and related queue metadata, including the target session ID, are stored locally
so the queue can survive restarts. The default queue file is `%DSH_HOME%\\priceflow\\queue.json`.
The balance API key is resolved and used on the Host side; PriceFlow does not send the raw key to th
e Client. Balance values are held in memory and are not intentionally persisted or logged by PriceFl
ow. PriceFlow does not add its own telemetry.
## Official sources

- DeepSeek pricing
- DeepSeek Chinese pricing
- DeepSeek balance endpoint
## Limitations
- Compatibility is intentionally limited to the independently verified DSH versions `0.2.0-rc.1` and

`0.2.0-rc.2`.
- Delayed queue sends support text only; attachments are not supported.
- Automatic s

cheduling requires a verified pricing policy.
- Missing holiday-calendar coverage may intentionally

disable automatic scheduling.
- Queue delivery is at-least-once; there is no general exactly-once gu

automatic scheduling.
- Queue delivery is at-least-once; there is no general exactly-once guarantee.
